entry.title: Label anything, anywhere: The ultimate personalised audio labeling tool

media:group.media:title: Label anything, anywhere: The ultimate personalised audio labeling tool
media:group.media:description:
Ever wondered how to easily identify everyday items around your home? In this video, we introduce SpeechLabels by Hable One, an innovative and accessible audio labeling system designed for people who are blind or have low vision.
SpeechLabels combines durable, reusable physical QR code stickers and NFC tags with a simple, screen-reader-friendly smartphone app. Whether you’re organizing groceries, identifying medication, or labeling clothing, you can record your own voice notes or type custom descriptions. Simply scan or tap your phone against the label to hear your saved information instantly—no guessing, no inaccuracy, and no stress.
Watch as we demonstrate how quick and easy it is to set up your labels and start labeling your home for greater independence!
Shop SpeechLabels at Vision Australia: https://shop.visionaustralia.org/campaigns/speech-labels.html

entry.title: Make tea time simple with the Accessible Hot Water Dispenser!

media:group.media:title: Make tea time simple with the Accessible Hot Water Dispenser!
media:group.media:description:
Tired of the heavy lifting and pouring that comes with a traditional kettle? Meet your new kitchen essential—the Accessible Hot Water Dispenser from the Vision Store!
Designed for people who are blind or have low vision, this compact, benchtop unit takes the stress out of making your morning tea, coffee, or a quick bowl of soup. No more worrying about heavy kettles or flat, touch-screen controls.
Key Features: - Simple & Tactile: Features a single, large, raised button that’s easy to locate by touch. - Total Control: Press once to dispense approximately 250ml of boiling water, and press again to stop the flow whenever you like. - Easy to Maintain: Includes a large, 2.5L removable water tank for simple filling and a front-mounted drip tray to keep your workspace tidy. - Safe & Fast: High-performance heating with built-in safety protections for peace of mind.
Whether you're looking for greater independence in your daily routine or just a faster, safer way to boil water, this dispenser is a game-changer. Learn more here: https://shop.visionaustralia.org/accessible-hot-water-dispenser.html
